'''Themog''' was a criminal operating in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. A former [[Corellian Security Force]] officer, Themog retired in disgrace after being injured while trying to shake down a suspect for a higher bribe to look the other way.<ref name="HNNA" />

Settling on Chrona, Themog was associated with a lot of the crime that plague the town of Corestrike. He retained the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[BG-12]], and was in a romantic relationship with [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Moira Kruger]]. Their relationship allowed him to hide out at [[the Grinder Dance Hall]], and to corrupt her vote on the [[Magistrate Council]].<ref name="HNNA" />
